summary:
Delivered `/work/converter/run.sh` + `/work/converter/convert.py` (pure Python 3 + NumPy, self-contained, no temp files, no network).

**Implementation (exactly per CONTRACT_IMAGE.md v1.0)**
- Platform: tech LEF → horizontal/vertical routing pitches; cell LEF → per-master `SIZE`, `CLASS`, and per-pin in-cell position = mean of the centres of all its PORT `RECT`s.
- Grid from `5_route.def`: `DIEAREA` bbox + `GCELLGRID STEP`, `nx=ceil(W/sx)`, `ny=ceil(H/sy)`, arrays `[i][j]=[x][y]`, cell area clipped to the die.
- Features (from `3_place.def` only): `cell_density`/`macro_region` = die-clipped footprint splat ÷ A(i,j) for PLACED/FIXED/COVER components with a LEF size (BLOCK split out); nets = `NETS` minus `USE POWER/GROUND`; connection points = `( PIN p )` port placement, or instance placement + orientation-mapped pin-centre offset (falling back to the placement point); `rudy` = centred `w×h` box (sides floored at one step) splatted with `d=(w+h)/(w·h)` then ÷ A; `pin_rudy` = Σ d at each point's GCell; `pin_density` = point counts.
- Labels (from `5_route.def`): segments = consecutive points inside each routing statement (`NEW`/`ROUTED` delimit statements, `*` repeats the previous coordinate, `( x y ext )` points handled, RECT/vias ignored); horizontal/vertical lengths (µm) split at GCell boundaries into Dh/Dv, out-of-grid dropped; capacity from LEF pitches; `congestion_raw = max(Dh/Ch, Dv/Cv)`; `congestion` = separable Gaussian σ=1, radius 4, whole-sample-symmetric reflect (`symmetric` padding), matching `scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter` defaults (scipy not installed, reimplemented).

**Verification**
- `check_format_image.py` passes (35/35 checks) on all 6 dev designs and on a synthetic 70 MB / 35 k-cell design.
- An independently written brute-force reference (separate parsing, per-cell loop splatting) matches every array bit-for-bit on 4 designs.
- Cross-checked against OpenROAD/ODB: instance footprints 386/386 identical, pin centres identical to `dbITerm::getAvgXY`, per-net connection counts identical, per-net routed wirelength identical (only difference: 34 nets whose DEF pin point carries the `ext` annotation — the spec uses the points only, so `ext` is ignored).
- Hand-verified all seven arrays on a tiny synthetic design (splat/clipping/divisors, boundary splitting, capacity, max-of-ratios) and validated edge cases (1-cell grids, unplaced/unknown instances, out-of-die points, empty nets).
- Runtime/memory: ≤2.5 s and ≤60 MB per dev design; ~8 s / 320 MB on the 70 MB stress design (chunked, memory-bounded rasterisation).
